basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Senior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is recruiting candidates for 1 project-based Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post under advertisement number IITD/IRD/302/2026. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay ranging from Rs. 17,790 - 49,220 to 60,530 - Rs. 62,350 per month. plus HRA @27%, renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project. Applicants must possess a Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration, management, support, accounting, documentation, or training. how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec.
Fill out the form completely with information regarding educational qualifications indicating percentages, division, details of work experience, advertisement number, etc.
Send the duly filled form via email to Prof. Ashok Kumar Patel at [email protected] and [email protected].
Include the Advertisement Number on the subject line of the email.
important_instructions: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. In case of selection of a retired or superannuated government employee, the salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. For any clarification regarding eligibility, candidates may contact Prof. Ashok Kumar Patel at email id: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Consolidated fellowship ranging from Rs. 17,790 - 49,220 to 60,530 - 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @27%

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post under the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational and experience requirements specified by the institute to apply for the post.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration/management/support/accounting/documentation/training, etc. Knowledge of research project administration/workflow and experience in coordination with funding agencies and government departments are required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is made on a contractual basis with consolidated fellowship pay ranging from Rs. 17,790 - 49,220 up to Rs. 60,530 - 62,350/- per month plus HRA at the rate of 27%. The tenure is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier, with the project duration extending up to 28.11.2027. For retired or superannuated government employees, salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates from those satisfying the advertised qualifications and requirements. The names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the web link at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with online interview details. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed for the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. In case of selection of a retired or superannuated government employee, the salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms. For any clarification regarding eligibility, candidates may contact Prof. Ashok Kumar Patel at email id: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the position?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting completed applications by email is 03/11/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Graduate degree with five years of work experience in project administration, management, support, accounting, documentation, or training, along with knowledge of research project administration and workflow.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the Sr. Project Assistant (Admin.) post?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship pay ranges from Rs. 17,790 - 49,220 up to Rs. 60,530 - 62,350/- per month plus HRA @27%.

faq.question: Q5. Is the job permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, which is upto 28.11.2027.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates must download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website and submit the duly filled form by email to [email protected] and [email protected] with the advertisement number in the subject line.

faq.question: Q7. Will there be an interview for selection?
faq.answer: Yes, shortlisted candidates will be called for an online interview after initial screening based on qualifications.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, a 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the shortlist of candidates be published?
faq.answer: The names of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the web link at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted along with online interview details.
